_comment: Style rules for content/blog, enforced by scripts/lint_content.py. 'prefer' maps a wrong spelling to the right one (case-sensitive, whole words). 'avoid' maps a word or phrase to the reason it is flagged.

avoid.simply: Tells the reader it's easy; if it isn't for them, it reads as a judgment. Cut it.
avoid.obviously: If it were obvious, it wouldn't need saying.
avoid.easily: Ease is the reader's call, not the writer's.
avoid.as mentioned above: Retrieval reads sections on their own; name the thing again.
avoid.see above: Retrieval reads sections on their own; link or repeat instead.
avoid.see below: Link to the section, or move the information here.
avoid.click here: Link text should say where the link goes.
